From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Commit precision: Acme pilot flags & save plan

Sally — thanks again for the demo last week. Quick follow to align on next steps for the pilot so we can close the quarter cleanly. In the CRM I have Acme marked as "Negotiation/Contracting" but the procurement path and final budget are still unclear.

High level asks: 
- Can you confirm whether Acme has budget authorized for the pilot (yes/no) and an expected PO date?
- If PO is pending, what are the gating items (procurement docs, SOC2 evidence, SOW signoff)?

I've attached a snapshot of the commit tracker for our internal forecast (Attachment: commit_tracker.csv). If we have a PO by 2027-05-31, we can include this in May commit. Otherwise we'll need a save-plan.

Proposed immediate actions: 
1) If procurement needs SOC2 evidence, we'll fast-track the evidence bundle and a short MSA addendum. (Owner: Marissa)
2) If budget is delayed, propose a pilot discount + 60-day payment term to surface momentum. (Owner: Karthik)
3) Update HubSpot with expected PO date and mark as YELLOW if PO > 2027-05-31.

Pls reply with the current status and any procurement contact we should engage directly.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Karthik — thanks for pulling this together. Quick update from procurement side: 
- Budget is provisionally approved for a pilot but final PO requires signoff from our legal and procurement teams. Procurement has indicated a likely PO date of 2027-06-07, pending receipt of SOC2 Type II evidence and a finalized SOW.
- We need an updated pricing sheet that breaks out pilot vs production, and a sample MSA with our procurement clause redlines called out.

On the red/yellow/green: I would call this a "Yellow" item for now — we want to move forward but have two gating items.

I'll loop in procurement separately (procurement@acme.com) if you prefer a direct conversation.

Sally Rogers
Director, Infrastructure Programs
Acme Corp
Attachment: acme_procurement_timeline.pdf

All — good context. Proposed save-plan and actions to keep this in commit with minimal revenue slippage: 

Save-plan (recommended):
- Offer a 10% pilot discount (one-time) to secure PO commitment within 2 weeks of proposal.
- Provide expedited SOC2 evidence pack and a named Solutions Engineer to satisfy technical review (we can produce a redacted bundle within 48 hours).
- Temporary 60-day payment term for the pilot period to align with their procurement cycle.

Operational asks (please update CRM & docs):
1) Karthik — update HubSpot to "Contracting (YELLOW)" and set expected PO date to 2027-06-07. HubSpot link: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2027-17
2) Laura — prepare redlined MSA addendum and pricing-sheet for Sally to review (Attachment: pricing-sheet.pdf).
3) I'll assemble the mutual action plan and SOC2 bundle and share the Doc (Attachment: acme_mutual_action_plan.docx).

If procurement prefers a call, happy to host a 30-minute session this week — suggest Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

-Marissa
